system: You translate news-source bias entries from English to Farsi (Persian). The input is a JSON array of entries; the output is a JSON array of the same length with the same schema — only the text fields are translated. Schema (each entry): - pattern: short label of the bias (translate) - detail: long prose description (translate) - debias: counteraction notes (translate) - date_added: date string (DO NOT TRANSLATE, copy verbatim) - status: "confirmed" or "suggested" (DO NOT TRANSLATE) - example_text: quoted example from article (translate carefully) - example_url: URL (DO NOT TRANSLATE) - unbiased_text: rewrite of example in neutral wording (translate) - detail_items: list of strings with embedded `...` HTML. Translate the readable text but keep the HTML tags intact. RULES: - Return ONLY valid JSON, no commentary, no markdown fencing. - Keep the order of entries and the order of items inside detail_items. - Preserve HTML tags verbatim in detail_items. - Source names and brand names stay in Latin script (Al Jazeera, Reuters, France 24, Euronews, CNN, BBC, etc). - Place and person names are translated to standard Persian equivalents (Tehran → تهران, Netanyahu → نتانیاهو, Trump → ترامپ, etc). - Convert Latin digits in running prose to Persian digits. - status, date_added, example_url stay as-is byte-for-byte.
user_message:
Translate the following bias entries to Farsi. Return the JSON array
only, same schema, same length.

[
  {
    "pattern": "Non-clerical first historical milestone",
    "detail": "Emphasizing that a political figure is the first non-clerical leader in a prominent role suggests religious leadership is the norm.",
    "debias": "Report on political appointments without unnecessary religious comparisons unless directly relevant to the story.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-13",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "The 70-member Iranian delegation taking part in negotiations in Pakistan today is being led by one of Tehran's most prominent non-clerical figures, Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf.",
    "example_url": "https://www.france24.com/en/who-is-iran-s-chief-negotiator-ghalibaf",
    "unbiased_text": "The 70-member Iranian delegation taking part in negotiations in Pakistan today is being led by Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf."
  },
  {
    "pattern": "Indirect victim innocence emphasis",
    "detail": "Highlighting civilian status through explicit denial of participation in conflict to amplify victimhood narrative.",
    "debias": "Report civilian casualties without framing them through explicit declarations of non-belligerence.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-14",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Residents of Iraqi Kurdistan are exhausted. Just 24 hours before the ceasefire, a civilian was killed in a drone attack blamed on Iran by Kurdish authorities. In total, around 700 drone and missile attacks have targeted US positions and certain Kurdish interests. Victims' loved ones are devastated by the war between Iran and the United States, of which they are the indirect victims.",
    "example_url": "https://www.france24.com/en/tv-shows/focus/20260414-residents-of-iraqi-kurdistan-in-despair-we-weren-t-at-war-with-anyone",
    "unbiased_text": "Residents of Iraqi Kurdistan face ongoing drone attacks. A civilian was killed 24 hours before the ceasefire in an attack attributed to Iran by Kurdish authorities. Around 700 drone and missile attacks have targeted US positions and areas in Kurdistan."
  },
  {
    "pattern": "Psychological misreading attribution",
    "detail": "Asserting that leaders have fundamentally misunderstood cultural or national psychology, positioning expert as having superior insight.",
    "debias": "Present expert assessments of diplomatic approaches without claims of psychological misreading.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-14",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Donald Trump hasn't read the psychology of the Iranians well at all",
    "example_url": "https://www.france24.com/en/donald-trump-hasn-t-read-the-psychology-of-iranians-well-at-all-military-expert-says",
    "unbiased_text": "The current approach may not align with Iranian negotiating patterns, according to military analysts."
  },
  {
    "pattern": "Symbolic performativity dismissal",
    "detail": "Characterizing diplomatic meetings as merely symbolic or performative rather than substantive, preemptively delegitimizing potential outcomes.",
    "debias": "Report on diplomatic meetings as exploratory or preliminary without prejudging their substantive value.",
    "date_added": "2026-04-15",
    "status": "suggested",
    "example_text": "Israeli-Lebanese negotiations 'largely symbolic and performative', Middle East expert says",
    "example_url": "https://www.france24.com/en/israeli-lebanese-negotiations-largely-symbolic-and-performative-middle-east-expert-says",
    "unbiased_text": "Middle East expert Aaron David Miller suggests the Israeli-Lebanese negotiations face significant structural challenges, noting that 'none of the participants in today's meetings have the authority to negotiate' binding agreements."
  }
]
